description: This file defines the BuzzPhoto entity class for the OrangeHRM system, representing photos attached to buzz posts with properties like filename, file type, size, dimensions, and the photo data itself. It includes ORM mappings and decorator traits.

classes.name: BuzzPhoto
classes.description: Entity class representing a photo attached to a buzz post, with properties for photo data, metadata, and ORM mappings.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the photo.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the photo.

methods.name: setPost
methods.description: Associates a BuzzPost entity with this photo.

methods.name: getPhoto
methods.description: Returns the photo data or resource.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of the photo.

methods.name: setFilename
methods.description: Sets the filename of the photo.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the file type of the photo.

methods.name: setFileType
methods.description: Sets the file type of the photo.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the photo.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the photo.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the photo.

methods.name: setWidth
methods.description: Sets the width of the photo.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the photo.

methods.name: setHeight
methods.description: Sets the height of the photo.
